jobs.title: Staff Backend Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
(Remote — North America, LATAM or Europe)

Nango (YC W23) is a developer infrastructure company and the leading provider of API access for agents and apps. It enables AI applications to connect to the real world through integrations.

More than 400 paying customers rely on Nango today, including Replit, Ramp, Mercor, Vapi, Instantly, and Exa. We are a YC-backed, multi-million ARR company with a team of 14 from AWS, Snyk, GitHub, Okta, Netlify, Uber, Samsara, and more.

We are hiring Senior & Staff Backend Engineers to join the core engineering team building Nango’s platform and developer infrastructure. This is a critical role at the heart of the company: as a product-led business selling to developers, our engineers directly drive the product roadmap, specifications, and execution. You will own core systems end-to-end, from ideation and design to implementation and close collaboration with developer customers, shaping both the platform and how Nango evolves.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and scale backend systems, APIs, and services for our open-source platform.

  • Build world-class developer interfaces: APIs, SDKs, UIs, and a runtime that delights developers.

  • Collaborate directly with customers to solve integration challenges.

  • Optimize performance, scalability, and reliability across backend services.

  • Shape the roadmap and company strategy with high ownership of key decisions.

  • Engage with the open-source community, owning and maintaining our repo.

Who you are

  • 5+ years (senior-level) or 10+ years (staff-level) of backend engineering experience, with proven ability to scale high-traffic systems.

  • Deep experience with developer infrastructure, APIs, databases, and performance-critical systems.

  • Passion for developer tools, best practices, and building outstanding DX.

  • Comfortable with Node.js and modern backend stacks.

  • Strong communicator, proactive, and reliable in a remote-first environment.

  • Product mindset and developer empathy: you optimize for DX.

  • Pragmatic, positive, and low ego: you step up in incidents and unblock teammates.

  • Startup-ready: autonomous, ownership-driven, and able to navigate ambiguity.

  • Based in North America, LATAM or Europe.

If you’re a seasoned backend engineer who loves developer infrastructure, thrives on ownership, and wants to shape the future of integrations — we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Technical Content Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
(Remote — North America, LATAM or Europe)

Nango (YC W23) lets developers build product integrations with AI. It enables applications to connect to the real world through integrations.

More than 500 paying customers rely on Nango today, including Replit & Ramp. We are a YC-backed, mid-seven-figure ARR company with a team of 14 from AWS, GitHub, Okta, Snyk, Netlify, Uber, Samsara, Workato, and other top-tier dev tools.

We are hiring a freelance Technical Content Engineer to scale our content for engineers building product integrations. This role is paid hourly ($30 to $150).

What You’ll Do

  • Write deeply technical content that educates developers on APIs, integrations, agents, and AI infrastructure.

  • Build prototypes and write code to understand firsthand what you write about.

  • Stay at the forefront of AI infrastructure and develop strong perspectives on where the industry is going.

  • Shape Nango’s vision and technical narrative alongside the founders and engineering team.

  • Make technical content a major driver of Nango’s awareness, adoption, and word of mouth.

Who You Are

  • You’re a software engineer with a strong computer science foundation.

  • You have experience with developer tools, APIs, infrastructure, or adjacent technologies.

  • You can explain complex technical ideas clearly and precisely. Professional writing experience is a plus, not a requirement.

  • You have the curiosity and technical depth to understand how things actually work.

  • You closely follow AI, agents, and the emerging infrastructure around them.

  • You have strong independent judgment: you can research a topic, find the interesting angle, and form your own point of view.

jobs.title: Developer Relations (Founding)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Nango (YC W23) lets developers build product integrations with AI. It gives agents and applications access to the APIs their users rely on.

More than 500 paying customers use Nango today, including ServiceNow, Monday, Replit, Ramp. We are a YC-backed team of 14 from AWS, GitHub, Okta, Snyk, Netlify, Uber, Samsara, Workato, and other leading developer-tool companies.

We are hiring a Founding Developer Relations Lead to make Nango known, trusted, and talked about by developers. You will combine technical building with content, events, and relationships—turning what AI builders care about into demos, use cases, and product ideas. You’ll work directly with the founders.

What You’ll Do

  • Build Nango’s presence across the AI developer ecosystem.

  • Speak at and organize conferences, meetups, and workshops.

  • Build relationships with developers, creators, customers, and partners.

  • Create demos and prototypes around agents, MCP, and integrations.

  • Produce developer-native content across social, video, and GitHub.

  • Help the community share what they are building with Nango.

  • Bring ecosystem insights back to Product and Engineering.

  • Track what resonates and continuously improve our outreach.

Who You Are

  • You have built software professionally and are comfortable writing code.

  • You have worked with AI, agents, APIs, MCP, OAuth, or developer tools.

  • You have created things that developers use or pay attention to.

  • You communicate technical ideas through demos, content, or talks.

  • You are comfortable representing a company publicly.

  • You understand what earns credibility with developers.

  • You enjoy building relationships in the San Francisco ecosystem.

  • You thrive when defining the playbook rather than following one.

Location

This is an in-person role in San Francisco.

jobs.title: Staff Platform Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
(Remote - North America, LATAM or Europe)

Nango (YC W23) is a developer infrastructure company and the leading provider of API access for agents and apps. It enables AI applications to connect to the real world through integrations.

More than 400 paying customers rely on Nango today, including Replit, Ramp, Mercor, Vapi, Instantly, and Exa. We are a YC-backed, multi-million ARR company with a team of 14 from AWS, Snyk, GitHub, Okta, Netlify, Uber, Samsara, and more.

We are hiring a Staff Platform Engineer to own the infrastructure Nango runs on - and increasingly, the infrastructure our customers run Nango on. This is a critical role at the heart of the company: as a product-led business selling to developers, our engineers directly drive the product roadmap, specifications, and execution. You will own our cloud platform end-to-end, lead our BYOC and private cloud deployments, and set the standard for how a small, autonomous team ships quickly and reliably at scale. You'll be the first person here whose primary focus is the platform beneath the product.

What You'll Do

  • Own and scale the cloud infrastructure behind our open-source platform: compute, networking, and the data layer.

  • Lead BYOC: turn customer-cloud deployments into a real product, with provisioning, upgrades, and observability that scale past bespoke work per deal.

  • Operationalize and productize our IaC and GitOps foundations so a small team keeps shipping fast as we grow.

  • Make reliability a product feature: meaningful SLOs, and an incident process people trust.

  • Lead our data layer: Postgres, Redis, Elasticsearch, and ClickHouse at growing scale.

  • Own the infrastructure side of security and compliance: SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA, enterprise security reviews.

  • Help shape the roadmap and company strategy with high ownership of key decisions.

Who you are

  • 10+ years (staff-level) in platform, infrastructure, DevOps, or SRE roles, with proven ability to run high-traffic systems in production.

  • Deep production Kubernetes experience, and opinions about when it's the wrong tool.

  • Experience operating software in environments you don't control: BYOC, single-tenant, on-prem, or air-gapped.

  • Deep AWS fluency, where we run today; exposure to GCP and Azure helps, since our customers don't all pick the same cloud.

  • Terraform as your native mode of working: modules others can use, safe state management, multi-account topologies.

  • Databases as a genuine strength, Postgres especially - performance work, migrations under load, replication.

  • Real compliance exposure: SOC 2 or ISO audits, pen tests, security reviews. You can tell substance from theatre.

  • Product mindset and developer empathy: you can read a customer issue and go build the fix. Our stack is TypeScript and Node.

  • Strong communicator, proactive, and reliable in a remote-first environment.

  • Pragmatic, positive, and low ego: you step up in incidents and unblock teammates.

  • Startup-ready: autonomous, ownership-driven, and able to navigate ambiguity.

  • Based in North America, LATAM or Europe.

If you're a seasoned platform engineer who loves developer infrastructure, thrives on ownership, and wants to shape the future of integrations - we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager (Founding)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Nango (YC W23) connects agents to 1,000 APIs so they can act & learn.

More than 700 paying customers use Nango today, including ServiceNow, Monday, Replit, Ramp. We are a YC-backed team of 14 from AWS, GitHub, Okta, Snyk, Netlify, Uber, Samsara, Workato, and other leading developer-tool companies.

We are hiring a Founding Customer Success Manager to help our customers succeed and grow with Nango. You will build our customer success function, working closely with our largest accounts while developing ways to support our broader customer base. You’ll own renewals, uncover new use cases, and work directly with the founders.

What You’ll Do

  • Build lasting relationships with developers, product leaders, and decision-makers at our largest customers.

  • Understand what customers are building and help them get more value from Nango.

  • Discover new use cases, teams, and integrations that drive account expansion.

  • Own renewals and expansion conversations, from planning through close.

  • Spot adoption gaps and risks early using product usage and customer conversations.

  • Partner with Engineering to resolve blockers and bring customer needs into the roadmap.

  • Build the playbooks and outreach that let us serve 700+ customers well.

  • Track customer health, retention, and growth as you build the function.

Who You Are

  • You have grown customer relationships at a developer tools, infrastructure, or technical SaaS company.

  • You have owned renewals and expansion, with results you can point to.

  • You are comfortable discussing APIs, integrations, and technical use cases with developers.

  • You build trust with both hands-on users and executive buyers.

  • You connect customer goals with product adoption and commercial opportunities.

  • You are organized, proactive, and thoughtful about where to spend your time.

  • You thrive when defining the playbook rather than following one.

Location

Remote in North America.

 - You have owned renewals and expansion, with results you can point to.

 - You are comfortable discussing APIs, integrations, and technical use cases with developers.

 - You build trust with both hands-on users and executive buyers.

 - You connect customer goals with product adoption and commercial opportunities.

 - You are organized, proactive, and thoughtful about where to spend your time.

 - You thrive when defining the playbook rather than following one.




LOCATION

Remote in North America.

jobs.title: Growth & Marketing Lead (Founding)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Nango (YC W23) lets developers build product integrations with AI. It gives agents and applications access to the APIs their users rely on.

More than 700 paying customers use Nango today, including ServiceNow, Monday, Replit, Ramp. We are a YC-backed team of 14 from AWS, GitHub, Okta, Snyk, Netlify, Uber, Samsara, Workato, and other leading developer-tool companies.

We are hiring a Founding Growth & Marketing Lead to make Nango known among developers and technical leaders, from startups with product-market fit to enterprises. You’ll work directly with the founders, turning creative experiments into awareness and qualified demand. You’ll start hands-on, with room to build a team as we grow.

What You’ll Do

  • Make Nango the go-to integrations brand for technical teams.

  • Grow channels across content, social, partnerships, and paid campaigns.

  • Host founder dinners, conference side events, and Nango events.

  • Sharpen our messaging and secure speaking opportunities.

  • Test unconventional ideas and scale the channels that work.

  • Track relevant awareness, qualified leads, and contribution to pipeline.

  • Build repeatable playbooks and, over time, a team.

Who You Are

  • You’ve run growth or marketing for developer tools or infrastructure.

  • You’ve personally grown multiple channels, with results to show.

  • You understand how developers discover, evaluate, and adopt tools.

  • You bring a network of founders, technical leaders, and developer creators.

  • You’ve reached technical buyers at growing startups and enterprises.

  • You bring proven playbooks and the judgment to adapt them.

  • You write clearly and enjoy executing the work yourself.

Location

This is an in-person role in San Francisco.
